x: The Shot Putt handicap was won by Les Stokell who is now taking up field events, he has ideas about becoming a decathion performer, and he certainly did well to take first place in the handicap with Frank Kemp second and a new member in R.
Bare, our high jumper, competed for an A.A.A. team at Eastbourne in a match against a combined Sussex and Kent side, and was second in the high jump with a leap of 6ft. R.

Ted Gaworski put the weight 43' 2" and the discus 135' 5" being 2nd in each event, whilst Percy Luxon won the Triple Jump with 45' 7" and the Long Jump with 20' 7". R. Harris finished 3rd in the weight with 41' 10".

The Shot Putt handicap was won by Les Stokell who is now taking up field events, he has ideas about becoming a decathion performer, and he certainly did well to take first place in the handicap with Frank Kemp second and a new member in R.
Not in the records, but scoring valuable points, were Discus - R.Harris, 121ft.10ins, third. Shot put - R.

In this, the last track match of the season, the outstanding feature was the absence of track men, despite which, with the aid of the field events men, who scored 23 points out of our total of 32, we won the trophy from Walton A.C. by one point. R.
We cannot keep our Field Events men out of the picture these days and they were busy putting the weight. R.Harris (scratch) won with a very good out of season putt of 44ft. 3ins.
A few days later R. Harris again put the shot 47ft. 3inches when representing A.A.A. v Oxford University and we look forward to even better efforts later in the year.

They were George Williams 3rd in the two miles walk (14.51.6), Mal Ash 2nd in the High Jump (5' 11") and R.J. Harris 4th in the Shot (48' 5") In addition Stan Vickers represented Kent in the 7 miles Walk and finished 4th in 52.19.4 in one of the finest races at this distance in post war years.
Brazier won the Junior 440 yards in 54.9s. with D. Mitchell 2nd and R.
